(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define palette (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (first g)))
    (define body (subgrid g 1 0 (- (rows g) 1) (- (cols g) 1)))
    (define (rect-frame? obj)
      (and (= (obj-color obj) 1)
           (>= (obj-h obj) 3)
           (>= (obj-w obj) 3)
           (= (obj-size obj) (- (* (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj))
                                (* (- (obj-h obj) 2) (- (obj-w obj) 2))))
           (all? (lambda (p)
                   (or (= (first p) (obj-r1 obj))
                       (= (first p) (obj-r2 obj))
                       (= (second p) (obj-c1 obj))
                       (= (second p) (obj-c2 obj))))
                 (obj-cells obj))))
    (define frames
      (sort (filter rect-frame? (objects body 0))
            (lambda (a b)
              (> (* (obj-h a) (obj-w a)) (* (obj-h b) (obj-w b))))))
    (define (frame-cells obj)
      (append
        (for/list ([c (in-range (obj-c1 obj) (+ (obj-c2 obj) 1))]) (list (obj-r1 obj) c))
        (for/list ([c (in-range (obj-c1 obj) (+ (obj-c2 obj) 1))]) (list (obj-r2 obj) c))
        (for/list ([r (in-range (obj-r1 obj) (+ (obj-r2 obj) 1))]) (list r (obj-c1 obj)))
        (for/list ([r (in-range (obj-r1 obj) (+ (obj-r2 obj) 1))]) (list r (obj-c2 obj)))))
    (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows body) (cols body) 0)])
              ([frame (in-list frames)] [idx (in-naturals)])
      (paint-cells out (frame-cells frame)
                   (if (< idx (length palette)) (list-ref palette idx) (last palette))))))
